hookText: Nvidia accounting under SEC investigation, sources say

beats.say: Nvidia is reportedly under SEC investigation over its accounting, according to sources cited by Yahoo Finance, as the stock extends a sharp sell-off.
Nvidia shed about $485 billion in market value Friday and nearly $900 billion this week, as its stock had its worst week since October 2008.
6 record, Nvidia has lost about $2.7 trillion in market value, more than the $2.5 trillion that The Kobeissi Letter called the biggest 45-day loss for any stock in history.
